test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

The teacher asked the students (1) / to write neatly (2) / and answer (3) / each questions carefully(4).
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error is located in part (4) of the sentence due to incorrect **noun-determiner agreement**.
 
• The word "**each**" is a distributive determiner that must always be followed by a **singular countable noun**.
 
• In this sentence, "**questions**" is a plural noun, which is grammatically incompatible with "each." It should be changed to the singular form "**question**."
 
• Thus, the phrase should correctly read: "**each question carefully**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The teacher asked the students to write neatly and answer **each question** carefully."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **(1): "The teacher asked the students"** – This part is grammatically correct, establishing the subject and the indirect object.
 
• **(2): "to write neatly"** – This is a correct use of the infinitive ("to write") followed by an adverb ("neatly") to describe the manner of writing.
 
• **(3): "and answer"** – This maintains parallel structure with "to write." The "to" is understood/carried over to the second verb ("to [write... and] answer").
